name: Gallery Nocturnea
description:
About This Game

Gallery Nocturnea is a boss-focused action game.
Ascend the mysterious and silent Moon Spire to become the ruler of the night. Uncover the secrets of the tower—and your own past.

The Moon Spire and the Gallery

Waking up without past memory, the protagonist is instinctively drawn to the Moon Spire. The rule of the spire's gallery is to meet challengers within the world of its paintings.

Conquer the worlds within the paintings as you ascend the tower. You can also explore the underground depths, defeat intruders, and collect treasures. Discover for yourself what awaits at the top of the tower!

Game Features

Combat is designed to be simple to control while delivering the thrill of boss encounters. Wait for openings through defense and dodging, then counterattack with combos and skills. Customize your playstyle with rings, skills, and items to create your own strategy. From duels against humanoid foes to battles with massive beasts, a variety of enemies await your challenge.

Simple yet dynamic pixel graphics faithfully capture the core appeal of classic action games. Experience a cute yet cool protagonist, the tower’s unique inhabitants, the silent tower, and the dazzling worlds within the paintings.

...Are you ready to face your past?

🌙
short_desc: Climb to the top of the spire in 'Gallery Nocturnea', a classic 2D action game focused on boss battles. Master a variety of actions like sword attacks, dodging, and parrying to defeat diverse bosses. Dive into mysterious painted worlds with charming pixel art characters.
